A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SkipGS work, and their text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison. All 16 pages of v1 and 17 pages of v2 were inspected; both end with references and contain no appendix.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original reconstruction-quality and training-time results on three datasets, including baseline comparisons in Tables 1–3 and a budget-control ablation in Table 4.

after.justification: Section 5 retains the original benchmark results, training profiling, qualitative comparisons, and budget-control ablation.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same per-view EMA gating, warmup, and calibrated minimum backward budget. The explicit Tpost = T − Td loop and local iteration indexing in v2 clarify the post-densification procedure already described in v1; they do not establish a changed training method.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Mip-NeRF 360, Deep Blending, and Tanks&Temples, retaining the same profiling and qualitative scenarios. Dynamic scenes appear only as future work in v2, not as added evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain vanilla 3DGS, FastGS, Taming 3DGS, GaussianSpa, LightGaussian, and Speedy-Splat, each with its SkipGS counterpart. Table 4 retains the same GaussianSpa and Taming 3DGS ablation comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported training schedule, metrics, hyperparameters, and baseline-combination protocol remain unchanged. The LightGaussian timing convention repeated in v2 Section 5.2 was already documented in v1 Table 1. Removing the Taming 3DGS 'Big' label does not establish a configuration change.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same budget-removal ablation and values for GaussianSpa and Taming 3DGS. The training profiling and qualitative comparisons also retain their original questions and evidence; no new robustness or sensitivity analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both report scene averages without experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 correct several total times and derived differences. For example, vanilla 3DGS + SkipGS changes from 1311.0 to 1311.1 seconds in Table 1 and from 1349.0 to 1349.5 seconds in Table 2; GaussianSpa's Table 2 PSNR difference changes from +0.07 to +0.08. Per-method quality scores and post-densification times remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 retain the same mathematical content. Sampled-view subscripts, iteration indexing, and the dummy summation index are clarified without changing definitions or reasoning. Neither version contains theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The central claims remain selective post-densification backpropagation, comparable reconstruction quality, and compatibility with existing acceleration methods. The abstract and contributions retain the same 23.1% total-time and 42.0% post-densification-time reductions on Mip-NeRF 360.

C2.justification: The v2 conclusion explicitly limits the experiments to static scenes and leaves dynamic scenes and models for future evaluation. This adds a substantive applicability qualification; the explanations of backward redundancy and budget control otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-repository URL and clarifies local iteration indexing, preservation of unsampled views' EMAs, and EMA updating after deviation-score calculation. It also removes the 'Big' configuration qualifier from Taming 3DGS in Table 1. Hardware and hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations for LPIPS and 4D Gaussian Splatting, supporting the existing metric and new dynamic-scene limitation. Research positioning in Section 2 remains unchanged. FastGS's preprint-to-conference reference update concerns the same work.

P1.justification: v2 makes local grammar, spelling, punctuation, affiliation-formatting, and notation edits, expands indexing explanations, and repeats the LightGaussian timing clarification in the results prose. The section sequence and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 changes from side-by-side qualitative/chart panels to photographs above a larger chart. Figures 2–3 receive sharper graphics and revised sizing or labels, including an expanded time-axis range in Figure 2. Captions and float placement change, while the same four figures and four table structures remain.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves internal consistency and readability through table-arithmetic corrections, clearer algorithm documentation, improved figures, a code-access link, and an explicit static-scene limitation. Removing Taming 3DGS's 'Big' qualifier slightly reduces configuration specificity. The net benefit is limited because the scientific method and experimental evidence are otherwise retained.
